scholarships_and_fellowships.mtech_teaching_assistantship: Rs. 12,400 per month for GATE-qualified candidates under MoE norms.

scholarships_and_fellowships.central_sector_scholarship_sc_st: Full tuition fee waiver, living allowance, books and computer grant for top-ranking SC/ST students.
